title: Git history of this PUBLIC repo still holds the account balances the v1 account snapshots committed (comms/mandate_evidence/account_snapshot/{alpaca_live,bybit_2}.json, 2026-09-30..2026-10-23); decide whether to purge
note: Filed 2026-11-01 by lane ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML (session_01AFoLuMP2ywy8v4RXABackp) on the manager instruction (Manager Session 2026-11-01a): "the public balance in comms/mandate_evidence/account_snapshot/alpaca_live.json ... is a rule violation ... file a row noting that git history still holds the old values". FIXED going forward (PR claude/account-snapshot-no-balance): the writer commits only per-leg affordability answers (schema 2, balance_committed false); tests/test_mandate_resolver.py::test_committed_snapshots_carry_no_balance pins it. NOT fixed: every earlier commit of those two files carries equity/buying power (e.g. git log -p -- comms/mandate_evidence/account_snapshot/). Purging needs a history rewrite of main (force-push, every clone invalidated): irreversible and outward-facing, so it is the operator's call, not a lane's. Options: (a) accept (small balances, already public), (b) git filter-repo + force-push with the operator coordinating clones.
